capabilities.label: Index-guided hybrid classification
capabilities.notes: A catalog entry does not imply coverage for every product, date, geography, or output.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Bounded index-guided selection and classification workflows documented for the beta.4 public release.

capabilities.label: Markdown workfiles and deterministic planning
capabilities.notes: Workflow-specific; exact source and geography limits still apply.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Workflow-specific deterministic planning with bounded local execution and explicit source limits.

capabilities.label: Bring Your Own Sauce / declarative Source Packs
capabilities.notes: No arbitrary Python, dynamic imports, shell hooks, or unrestricted templates.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Declarative Source Pack validation and planning contracts; no arbitrary code execution.

capabilities.label: Declarative Source Pack v2 contracts
capabilities.notes: Source Pack v1 compatibility remains preserved; v2 adds explicit asset-access and credential boundaries.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Versioned v2 asset-access and materialization contracts; public execution remains bounded and provider-specific.

capabilities.label: Sauce Time ranked temporal alternatives
capabilities.notes: Never substitutes the requested time without explicit selection.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Explicit temporal-alternative planning without silent substitution.

capabilities.label: Reusable preview templates
capabilities.notes: Declarative roles and layouts only; render contracts remain authoritative, including classification audit legends and provenance.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Declarative preview layout and provenance contracts only.

capabilities.label: CRS-aware categorical area accounting
capabilities.notes: Native class counts remain exact; physical areas use a declared equal-area grid and reconcile to the valid footprint.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Equal-area categorical inventory and reconciled valid-footprint accounting.

capabilities.label: Classification confidence-threshold provenance
capabilities.notes: Plans, model receipts, final receipts, inspection, and publication evidence preserve the configured metric, threshold, unknown class, and source.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Provenance-preserving confidence and threshold metadata; not an accuracy claim.

capabilities.label: Coherent NAIP-CDL temporal repair
capabilities.notes: Ranks coherent imagery and weak-label year pairs before imagery-only choices; selection is explicit, immutable, and performs no raster acquisition.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Explicit temporal repair selection for NAIP/CDL planning.

capabilities.label: Public credential-requirement contract
capabilities.notes: Resolved secrets are excluded from public plans, logs, cache keys, receipts, and archives.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Public credential-reference and pre-network failure boundary only.

capabilities.label: Versioned generic STAC asset-access contracts
capabilities.notes: Direct HTTPS, bearer HTTPS, ephemeral signer, public S3, and Requester Pays S3 are provider-neutral v2 contracts; authenticated execution is private.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Provider-neutral STAC asset-access contracts without universal execution.

capabilities.label: Closed Earth Engine computation contracts
capabilities.notes: The public compiler emits a deterministic closed operation list and output grid; the public repository does not execute Earth Engine.
capabilities.scientific_scope: Closed Earth Engine computation contract compilation without public execution.

capabilities.label: Authenticated parallel execution backend
capabilities.notes: The public repository defines only frozen, versioned input and evidence contracts.

capabilities.label: Arbitrary-code source plugins
capabilities.notes: Declarative Source Packs are the supported extension seam.

evidence_definitions.contract_validated: Schema/compiler validation only; no live dataset claim.
evidence_definitions.fixture_validated: Deterministic checked-in fixtures exercise the contract.
evidence_definitions.live_dataset_certified: A checked-in sanitized receipt, present at the declared public commit, proves a named live dataset validation.
evidence_definitions.live_route_certified: A checked-in sanitized receipt, present at the declared public commit, proves a bounded live route.

prism_ames_2023.scope: Ames PRISM daily ZIP validation, bounded public route

release_state_definitions.planned: Directional work without an executable public contract.
release_state_definitions.private: Consumed only by a proprietary execution backend; no private implementation is public.
release_state_definitions.published: Included in the published public beta.
release_state_definitions.unreleased_public: Implemented or contracted in the public source tree but not part of the published beta contract.
release_state_definitions.unsupported: Explicitly outside the current public product.

sources.label: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer
sources.notes: Categorical outputs require nearest or mode resampling.
sources.scientific_scope: Exact-year categorical CDL workflows with declared resampling semantics.

sources.label: USGS NAIP imagery
sources.notes: Exact-year coverage is fail-closed; available years are advisory until selected.
sources.scientific_scope: Shipped agricultural NAIP workflows with fail-closed exact-year coverage.

sources.label: USGS 3DEP
sources.notes: Available only where a shipped workflow declares the terrain role.
sources.scientific_scope: Recipe-bounded terrain role in shipped workflows.

sources.label: PRISM daily precipitation ZIP
sources.notes: Complete-object materialization requires explicit approval and byte ceilings.
sources.scientific_scope: Guarded PRISM daily precipitation validation and bounded materialization only.

sources.label: CHIRPS, gridMET, TerraClimate, and WorldClim
sources.notes: Catalog presence does not imply a runnable end-to-end workflow.
sources.scientific_scope: Bounded probe and fixture paths for catalog-backed climate sources; no universal workflow execution.

sources.label: Copernicus Data Space STAC
sources.notes: Public contracts can plan requirements; the public runtime never resolves credentials.
sources.scientific_scope: Public Copernicus contract and resolver boundary without credential resolution.

status_definitions.planned: Directional work without an executable public contract.
status_definitions.private: Consumed only by a proprietary execution backend; no private implementation is public.
status_definitions.released: Legacy alias for published; retained for Source Pack v1 compatibility.
status_definitions.unsupported: Explicitly outside the current public product.
